coverage_tiers.daily: Tracked in weekday technical and deployment workflow
coverage_tiers.event: Tracked primarily around catalysts, earnings, and targeted refreshes
coverage_tiers.macro: Tracked as macro sleeve or hedge expression, not as a core equity deployment board name
coverage_tiers.watch: Watchlist presence only, not active machine-tracked execution coverage

state_types.DEPLOYABLE: Structured and in-band with no blocking event
state_types.ALMOST: Constructive but not yet at disciplined entry
state_types.BLOCKED: Hard event blocker or timing blocker active
state_types.REPAIR: Prior setup failed or chart is broken and needs repair before new deployment work
state_types.WATCH: Not decision-grade yet, missing levels or active execution policy
state_types.MACRO: Macro sleeve or hedge, evaluated separately from core equity deployment workflow
